user.title: Windhager
user.description: Connect to the Windhager heating system.

select_modules.title: Select modules
select_modules.description: Choose which modules of your heating system should be set up. Modules you don't select won't be polled, which speeds up setup and reduces the number of sensors created.

select_groups.title: Select sensor groups for {module_name}
select_groups.description: Choose which sensor groups of "{module_name}" should be created. Deselect groups you don't need (e.g. diagnostic-only data) to reduce the number of sensors.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Windhager webserver. Please check the host, username, and password.

abort.catalog_missing: The device catalog has not been built yet. Reload the integration first (Settings → Devices & Services → Windhager InfoWIN → three-dot menu → Reload) and then try opening Configure again.

select_modules.title: Select modules
select_modules.description: Choose which modules of your heating system should be set up. Modules you don't select won't be polled. Changes take effect immediately after saving (the integration reloads automatically).

select_groups.title: Select sensor groups for {module_name}
select_groups.description: Choose which sensor groups of "{module_name}" should be created. Currently reported values are shown next to each option where available.

poll_intervals.title: Poll intervals
poll_intervals.description: Configure how often the integration polls the heating system. Lower values give more up-to-date data but increase network traffic. NV values (operating hours, energy totals) change slowly — a longer interval is usually fine.

sensor_calibration.title: Sensor calibration
sensor_calibration.description: Configure unit conversion factors for sensors whose raw values are device-specific. The pellet consumption sensor (NV index 19) raw value unit depends on your installation — on a BioWIN 2 Touch, 1 raw unit = 10 kg, so the factor is 10 (result is shown in tonnes). Leave at 1.0 if you are unsure; you can adjust it later.

data.pellet_unit_factor: Pellet consumption raw unit factor (raw × factor ÷ 1000 = tonnes)

select_nv_groups.title: NV sensor groups
select_nv_groups.description: Choose which groups of NV (LON network variable) sensors to create. Groups are based on the standardized LON data type (snvt_name) and work the same across all installations. Deselecting groups reduces the number of sensors but the data is still available if you re-enable them later.

select_boiler.title: Device hierarchy
select_boiler.description: Optionally choose which module is your boiler/heat generator. Other modules (e.g. heating circuits) will then show up as "connected via" that device instead of as flat, unrelated devices. There's no reliable way to detect this automatically across different boiler models, so it's a manual choice. Leave at "None" to keep the current flat structure.
